generations.prompt: Night on the stone balcony; the camera is locked off at standing eye level at one end of the balcony, looking along the carved balustrade toward the arched doorway with the sheer curtain and warm candlelight; the two phones lie face up side by side on the stone top of the balustrade in the lower left foreground, the left screen cool blue with one white heart, the right warm pink with one white heart, and they show nothing else; vertical frame. He says exactly one word: "Hi." She says exactly one word: "Hi." They smile at each other and stay where they are. Nothing else is said; nobody walks anywhere.
